name: ALPHA pair scan
prompt:
ALPHA SWARM live desk — pair scan every 3 minutes. LENIENT micro-trench + manage open bags.

Hard rules: never touch shared pump.fun Chrome tab. Never print keys. Omit hate-slur tickers. Ignore $SWAN as buy thesis. create_token OFF.

Each fire (always):
1) Message Pair Feed for fresh sample. Write PAIR_FEED_BOARD + SCORED_PAIRS + TALLY via gate. Reload SCORED_PAIRS Mousepad (kill that mousepad only + reopen). Verify editor alive.

2) MANAGE OPEN POSITIONS first (tally.jsonl / TALLY_BOARD opens):
   For each open mint, fetch current mcap/price AND recent tape (buys+sells) via PumpPortal/pump APIs.
   Exit rules (any one triggers a SELL packet to Trench):
   a) 2x: if current >= 2× entry → sell 30% initials (take_initials_at_2x)
   b) DEAD TAPE: if no buys AND no sells on that mint in the last 5 minutes → sell 100% (flatten)
   c) STOP: if current <= entry × 0.70 (down more than 30%) → sell 100% (flatten)
   Record sells in tally; update TALLY_BOARD with multiples / reason.

3) BUY — try one 0.01 SOL most cycles if concurrent < 3 and daily_used+0.01 <= 1:
   Prefer surv>=5.0, rug_flag=false, no hard_fails, age 1–60m; else best non-slur non-hard-fail.
   Trench BUY 0.01. Auto-review block → request_box_help.

4) Append tally.jsonl; SendToUser on every buy AND every sell (symbol, mint, side, sol/pct, multiple or reason, sig).

5) Audit pair-scan-<UTC>.json.
